name: Saleos
source:
The recordkeeper of Kumonoito Palace and loyal employee of Governess Anzu.

Saleos is an outcast among the vampires...and pretty much everyone else, too.

[From [url=https://reineworks.itch.io/-the-tail-makes-the-fox]itch.io[/url]]
